Title: Clearing a required field on an existing record blocks the save and shows its message
Step Action: Follow the click path in the current row to the record.
Step Expected: The record form opens with its values.

Step Action: Clear the field named in the row.

Step Expected: The page stays on the form and nothing is saved.
The message in the row is shown.

Step Action: Check the page for a server error message.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.
